steps: Apply free on callcenterqa.org/employment with your PayPal email
Complete the one unpaid test call and submit the evaluation
Get approved and wait for paid call lists by email
Make the calls (5–15 min each) and file the 1-page feedback form
Paid $6–$8 per call via PayPal in 1–5 business days
timing: PayPal payout in 1–5 business days per completed call evaluation.
who_pays: Call Center QA pays you via PayPal for each completed telephone mystery shop and feedback form.
who_qualifies: 18+, current US resident. No experience, background check, or W-9 required (a W-9 only if you earn $600 or more). You need good listening and writing skills and strong attention to detail — and the same PayPal email on every form, or payments can't be matched to you.
work_available: Paid work arrives as emailed call lists — it is not on-demand, and volume can be very low; some shoppers report only a handful of paid calls over several years. After you finish your first paid list, you go on a waiting list for more calls matching your profile. There is no guaranteed volume.
what_gets_accepted: First you must pass the unpaid test call: complete one test-call option, act like a real potential customer, never disclose you're a mystery shopper, use real contact information, don't hang up, and keep the call to at least 3 minutes. For paid work, complete each assigned call and file the one-page feedback form.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No registration fee to apply or work with them. Unpaid time: the application, the unpaid test call (about 10 minutes plus the evaluation form), and writing the one-page feedback form after each paid call.
when_cash_arrives: Paid via PayPal within 1–5 business days of completing each call evaluation — fast compared to the 30–45 day waits typical of other mystery-shopping companies.
